name: Speaker ring
for: A call, presence or team card: the active person's avatar gets a thin ring of the effect with its own soft glow, and the ring glides to whoever speaks next.
how: One small effect host (avatar plus 16px) shaped by a radial mask into a 2.5px ring and a fading glow; it moves by transform, so one canvas serves every avatar.
rules: One lit ring at a time.
The ring moves only on a state change (a new speaker, a status), never on a timer faster than 3 s.
Avatars are the people's own photos or initials, never stock faces.
a11y: The speaker is named in text next to the bars; the ring and bars are decorative. Reduced motion holds the first speaker and stops the bars.
